The same measure during the pre-question baseline window. People differ hugely in resting brow height, so only the change from this value is meaningful.
Absolute difference between left and right delta. Asymmetric brow movement is associated with deliberate rather than spontaneous expression.
Mean absolute brow delta across both sides.
Discrete raise events detected in the answer window.
Rate of change of eyebrow velocity.

Distance from left brow centre to left eye centre, divided by inter-ocular distance. Dividing by inter-ocular distance cancels camera distance, so leaning toward the webcam does not look like a brow raise.
Computed as left_eyebrow_eye_distance minus its baseline. THIS is the eyebrow-raise feature to model on, not the absolute distance.
Current brow-eye distance divided by baseline. Scale-free alternative to the delta.
Peak raise divided by rise time, in inter-ocular units per second. Fast micro-raises differ from slow deliberate ones.
